note: Set A's five claims all match the text exactly, including the θ = 0º conditions on KP and KI and the two distinct stated reasons for using ζφ = 0.7. Set B repeats those five correct claims but adds six chart-derived readings, five of which are plainly wrong: they bind axis tick labels (0.000, 0.020, 0.0) to gain values at 0º, contradicting the stated KP(0º)=0.01882681 s, KI(0º)=0.008068634 and the curve that starts at GK=1.0, and it reads KP(20º) as 0.010 s where the blue curve is near 0.005 s. The extra claims are spliced axis-label strings rather than quotes that support the claims, so B adds noise without adding reliable information.
remarks: Both sets omit the gain-correction factor law GK(θ) = 1/(1 + θ/θK) (Eq. 7-20) and the implementation detail that the previous time step's blade-pitch angle is used to compute the next step's gain-correction factor. B's chart claims appear to be generated by pairing axis tick labels with series names rather than reading the plotted curves; the '0.2 at 20º' gain-correction factor claim is the only one roughly consistent with the curve (~0.24) but its quote is still a spliced label string. Note also that both sets state ζφ = 0.7 twice with different condition phrasings; these are two distinct facts about the same value rather than true duplicates.
